notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}.
description:
Activate Lady Octopus by tapping it, causing you to cast Ancestral Statue without paying its mana cost.
When Ancestral Statue enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.name: Lady Octopus, Inspired Inventor
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with four or more ingenuity counters on it
